latin: Sicut homo et sacerdos inferior sacrificat deo animas animalium irrationalium, ita Michael sacerdos superior sacrificat animas animalium rationalium.
translation: As the lower priest, man offers up to God the souls of unreasoning animals; Michael, priest of the higher order, offers the souls of reasoning ones.
